description: Apps targeting API 31+ that ship an AccessibilityService must complete a Play Console declaration; only genuine accessibility tools (isAccessibilityTool=true) are exempt from prominent-disclosure and consent requirements.
effect_on_corpus: Benign side: legitimate non-tool apps begin shedding the service. Malicious side: unaffected (sideloaded). Separation power of this feature RISES after this date.

description: Loan facilitators must name partner NBFCs/banks and hold RBI licence declarations; ~3,500 loan apps subsequently removed.
effect_on_corpus: Removes a large benign lending subpopulation from Play. Any lending app still present after this date is a differently-selected sample.

event: Personal Loan policy: SMS and call-log restriction
description: Financial apps barred from accessing SMS content, call logs, contacts, photos and location for loan risk assessment.
effect_on_corpus: The single largest benign-side shift in this corpus. SMS-reading stops being normal for finance apps, so the feature's malicious-class weight increases sharply.

description: Enforcement deadline for the April 2025 financial-app permission and metadata rules.
effect_on_corpus: Expect a step change, not a ramp, in benign SMS-permission prevalence around this month.

description: Every app on a Play developer account must complete a Financial features declaration; updates blocked until filed.
effect_on_corpus: Improves the reliability of Play's own FINANCE categorisation from this date onward - useful for the benign sampling frame, and a discontinuity to declare.

description: Android begins requiring apps to be registered by verified developers to install on certified devices.
effect_on_corpus: Pushes malware further toward sideloading and non-certified paths; certificate features drift in meaning.

description: Google reports 1.75M policy-violating apps blocked from publication in 2025 and 80,000 bad developer accounts actioned.
effect_on_corpus: Prevalence on Play is heavily suppressed by upstream filtering - so a Play-sampled benign pool is NOT a random sample of what users can install.
